sn45.161:1.1: Sāvatthinidānaṃ || || (I. Abhiññā) Tisso imā bhikkhave esanā || katamā tisso || || Kāmesanā bhavesanā brahmacariyesanā || || Imā kho bhikkhave tisso esanā || || Imāsam kho bhikkhave tissannam esanānam abhiññāya ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabbo || katamo ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo || || Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhim bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ || la [pe] || sammāsamādhim bhāveti viveka- virāganirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ || || Imāsaṃ kho bhikkhave tissannam esanānam abhiññāya ayam ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabbo ti
